gloss.en: The root كسل (ksl) in form IV, أَكْسَلَ عَنْهَا, describes the act of penetration without ejaculation. It implies that one entered but then withdrew without releasing semen.
gloss.short: The root كسل (ksl) in form IV, أَكْسَلَ عَنْهَا, describes the act of penetration without ejaculation.
